component.name: Writing Tools
component.summary: Rewrite, proofread and summarize selected text with AI on X11

description.p: Writing Tools uses AI to proofread, rewrite and summarize selected text. It supports Gemini, OpenAI-compatible endpoints and Ollama.
This is an independent Linux build produced by rhgKc2yp/writingtools-release, not an upstream release. Report packaging problems to that repository.

Global shortcuts, selection capture and text replacement require an X11 desktop session. Native Wayland applications are not supported. Configure an AI provider after launching; cloud providers receive the text you send.
